Home.gdprWhatMeansTitle: What does this mean for you and your personal data?
Home.gdprWhatMeansText: Your personal data is any information that relates to you and on the basis of which you are identifiable to us as a natural person. This occurs in cases where we can identify you directly or indirectly, in particular on the basis of a generally applicable identifier or other identifier, such as name, surname, identification number, location data or online identifier. Personal data therefore includes in particular contact details of a natural person, their IP address, may be information about the use of services or about activities and preferences of a natural person.
Home.gdprDataCollectedText: During your visit to our website, we record the IP address assigned to you by your internet provider, from which websites you visited our site, how long you stayed on our site, which specific subpages you view, and more. This information is considered personal data as it is your online identifier, and therefore we handle this data with increased care.

BivajArt.title: Bivaj Art Luthery
BivajArt.subtitle: High-quality musical instruments from Transylvania
BivajArt.intro: At the Bivaj Workshop in Transylvania, master craftsmen Vajai Ferenc and Biro István (affectionately known as the "old boys") handcraft top-quality stringed instruments with unmatched precision and passion. We specialize in double basses, but also build cellos, viola da gambas, and violons, inspired by historical music traditions. Every instrument is individually designed, features our custom internal label, and comes with a certificate of authenticity.
BivajArt.materials: All wood is sourced from the Carpathians and air-dried for years. The tops are made of high-grade resonance spruce, with two-piece curly maple backs, ribs, and necks. We use ebony for the fingerboard and tailpiece, and select maple for the bridge.
BivajArt.craftsmanship: Each instrument is completely handmade using traditional methods. Our signature antique-style varnish combines Joha original spirit-based lacquer and natural resins, enhancing both look and sound. We also create custom mechanisms and artistic bass keys with innovative designs.
BivajArt.conclusion: Whether you're a soloist or orchestral performer, a Bivaj instrument offers superior tone, craftsmanship, and timeless character, a true one-of-a-kind creation.
